lines.text: It's so nice being able to talk to you alone.
What's wrong with the group chat?

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Erm...

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: I don't think I'll be using that for a while.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Naga and I are competitors now, after all.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Given the dynamic between us at the moment,

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: it'd hardly be prudent for us to be sharing information with each other

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: in the group chat.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: So I figure it's best if I just talk to you like this.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Just the two of us♥
Fair enough.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Haha. Great!

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Oh, happy day!

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: I just can't get enough of shopping.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Nothing beats the thrill of taking part in a raffle, either.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Even though you were the only one who won a prize.
I was just lucky.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: LOL

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: You know what?

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: I had a feeling you were going to win.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Dunno why, just did.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: So you can imagine how happy I was when you actually won!

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: It was like I'd won the lottery myself.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: I get to see you tomorrow too, right?

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: I'm gonna be way too excited to sleep tonight XD

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: I'm just so happy♥

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: See you tomorrow, Teacher♥

lines.speaker: cupidtia
lines.text: Bye!
